indications: Acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablets are indicated for the maintenance of abstinence from alcohol in patients with alcohol dependence who are abstinent at treatment initiation ( 1 , 14 ). Treatment with acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablets should be part of a comprehensive management program that includes psychosocial support ( 1 ).
contraindications: Recommended dose: 666 mg (two 333 mg tablets) taken three times daily ( 2 ). Dose reduction to one 333 mg tablet taken three times daily for patients with moderate renal impairment (creatinine clearance 30 to 50 mL/min) ( 2.1 ). Acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablets are contraindicated in patients with severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance of ≤30 mL/min) ( 2.1 , 4.2 , 5.1 , 8.6 , 12.3 ).

adverseReactions: Acamprosate calcium is contraindicated in patients who previously have exhibited hypersensitivity to acamprosate calcium or any of its components ( 4.1 ). Acamprosate calcium is contraindicated in patients with severe renal impairment ( 4.2 ).
